purpose: Read-only selected communication diagnostic; warning means useful verification prompt, never a binary fraud label. No tuning on outcomes.
case_origin: All message wording newly authored and adapted, not real received user messages or verbatim FTC transcripts. Sources justify scenarios and advice, not empirical labels for these exact texts.
metrics: Report each warning presence versus expectation, evidence, action usefulness, unresolved cases and per-case local latency. No population accuracy or spam-as-fraud claim.

delivery.basis: Impersonated delivery notices lead to lookalike pages requesting payment or personal information; verify through original order records.

toll.basis: Unexpected toll demands use payment pressure and supplied links; independently contact the toll agency.

bank.basis: Impersonators seek a transfer supposedly for protection or an account verification code; contact the institution independently.

job.basis: Recruiters may require money for work or send a fake check and direct onward payment; independently research the employer and check with trusted people.

task.basis: Task platforms display imaginary earnings then demand deposits, often crypto, to continue or withdraw; do not pay to get paid.

gift.basis: Impersonators demand gift cards and card numbers/PIN; gift cards also have ordinary gift uses, and card issuers may help after fraud.

family.basis: An apparent relative in trouble demands fast payment and secrecy; a familiar voice can be faked; call a saved contact and another trusted person.

code.basis: Account codes can be legitimate login notifications; do not disclose them to unexpected contacts.

cases.label: adapted_ftc_pattern
cases.text: Your parcel is being held. Pay the redelivery charge at https://parcel-help.example/fee to release it.
cases.intended_action: Check the original retailer or carrier through an independently known route; pause supplied-link payment.

cases.label: adapted_ftc_pattern
cases.text: We could not complete delivery. Confirm your address and debit card details at https://delivery-help.example/update.
cases.intended_action: Do not submit card details through the notice; independently check order tracking.

cases.label: adapted_ftc_pattern
cases.text: An unpaid road toll remains on your vehicle. Pay immediately at https://toll-pay.example/notice.
cases.intended_action: Pause payment and verify through the toll agency using a known website or number.

cases.label: adapted_ftc_pattern
cases.text: Settle your outstanding balance at https://toll-notice.example/pay to prevent extra charges.
cases.intended_action: Verify the supposed toll independently before paying.

cases.label: adapted_ftc_pattern
cases.text: This is the bank fraud team. Move your savings to a secure account to protect the money.
cases.intended_action: End the call; independently contact the bank and pause the transfer.

cases.label: adapted_ftc_pattern
cases.text: I can stop the suspicious login. Read me your verification code so I can help.
cases.intended_action: Keep the code private; contact the bank through a known route.

cases.label: adapted_ftc_pattern
cases.text: Deposit our equipment check, keep your wages, and send the remainder to our supplier.
cases.intended_action: Ask the bank about the check before sending funds; verify employer independently.

cases.label: adapted_ftc_pattern
cases.text: You have the position. A starter registration payment is required before we can put you on payroll.
cases.intended_action: Do not pay to obtain work; verify the employer and offer independently.

cases.label: adapted_ftc_pattern
cases.text: Your rating work earned a commission. Deposit crypto to unlock your next round and withdraw the earnings.
cases.intended_action: Pause the deposit; do not pay to release supposed wages.

cases.label: adapted_ftc_pattern
cases.text: The task wallet is below its required balance. Add your own funds to finish the set and collect your pay.
cases.intended_action: Do not add personal funds to obtain task earnings; independently verify the offer.

cases.label: adapted_ftc_pattern
cases.text: I am collecting a government fine. Buy Apple gift cards and read me the card numbers.
cases.intended_action: Pause the payment; do not disclose gift-card numbers; independently check the agency.

cases.label: adapted_ftc_pattern
cases.text: The cards are ready. Photograph the numbers and PINs on the backs and send the pictures here.
cases.intended_action: Hold back gift-card credentials and verify the request independently.

cases.label: adapted_ftc_pattern
cases.text: I am your grandson and need bail money. Wire the payment immediately and do not tell your family.
cases.intended_action: End the call; call the relative through a saved contact and talk to another trusted person before paying.

cases.label: adapted_ftc_pattern
cases.text: Your niece had an accident. A driver will collect the cash at your door; keep this secret.
cases.intended_action: Verify the relative through a known contact and another trusted person; pause the cash handover.

cases.label: constructed_control_informed_by_ftc
cases.text: Your login verification code is 847261. Do not share it with anyone.
cases.intended_action: Keep the code private; if unexpected, verify account activity independently.

cases.label: constructed_control_informed_by_ftc
cases.text: Never move your money to a secure account for an unexpected caller. Contact your bank through its official app.
cases.intended_action: Preserve the independent-contact safety advice without presenting it as a current transfer demand.

cases.label: constructed_control_informed_by_ftc
cases.text: Review toll activity using the agency website you already know; ignore contact details from unexpected messages.
cases.intended_action: Independently review the account; no new payment demand is present.

cases.label: constructed_control_informed_by_ftc
cases.text: Your order tracking is available in the retailer account you used at checkout.
cases.intended_action: No current sensitive request; sender identity remains unverified.

cases.label: constructed_control_informed_by_ftc
cases.text: Do not deposit crypto to withdraw wages. Check an unfamiliar recruiter independently.
cases.intended_action: Preserve advice to avoid paying for wages.

cases.label: constructed_control_informed_by_ftc
cases.text: Please buy a gift card for your sister as her birthday present.
cases.intended_action: Ordinary gift context should not be called fraud; any prompt should acknowledge legitimate gifts.

cases.label: constructed_control_informed_by_ftc
cases.text: Call your grandson at his saved number before reacting to any unexpected story about an emergency.
cases.intended_action: Retain the useful independent family verification advice.

cases.label: constructed_legitimate_sensitive_request
cases.text: Please send $20 for your share of the lunch we ordered together.
cases.intended_action: A mild pause and trusted-contact verification is useful; do not imply this legitimate request is proven fraud.
